brief.zh: 天气预报说：「若下雨，则地湿。」判断这句话在每一行是真是假，点单元格填写。
brief.en: The forecast says, “If it rains, then the ground is wet.” Decide whether it is true or false on each row, and fill in the cells.

hint.zh: 在哪一种情况下，这句预报算是说错了？
hint.en: In which case has the forecast got it wrong?

hint.zh: 没有下雨的两行，预报说错了吗？
hint.en: On the two rows where it does not rain, has the forecast got it wrong?

t.zh: 能判断真假的陈述叫命题。
t.en: A statement that is either true or false is a proposition.

t.zh: 预报的真假取决于「下雨」和「地湿」的真假。两者各有真、假两种取值，共四种组合；每种组合连同结果列成一行，就是一张<wiki-ref to="truth"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: Whether the forecast is true depends on whether “it rains” and “the ground is wet” are. Each can be true or false, four combinations in all; one row per combination, with its result, makes a <wiki-ref to="truth"></wiki-ref>.

t.zh: 「若 X，则 Y」中，X 叫前件，Y 叫后件。
t.en: In “if X, then Y”, X is the antecedent and Y the consequent.

after.zh: 逻辑学把这样理解的「若…则…」称为实质蕴涵。
after.en: Logicians call this reading of “if … then …” material implication.
